info.name: Node Commerce
info.description: Node Commerce API. Set {{BASE_URL}}, run Auth > login to populate {{token}}, then exercise any folder. Several list endpoints capture a first id into a collection variable (productId, categoryId, orderId, userId) so follow-up requests resolve without manual copy/paste.

exec: // Generate an Idempotency-Key per run if the request needs one.

body.raw:
{
    "name": "Test Product {{$timestamp}}",
    "description": "A descriptive sample product for API testing purposes.",
    "price": 250000,
    "stock": 25,
    "imageUrl": "https://picsum.photos/seed/sample/400/400",
    "categoryId": "{{categoryId}}"
}

{
    "vendorId": "{{vendorId}}",
    "orderId": "{{orderId}}",
    "productId": "{{productId}}",
    "subject": "Order never arrived",
    "body": "My order shows delivered but I did not receive it.",
    "priority": "HIGH"
}

item.name: Search
item.description: Mega search across products, categories, users and reviews. The active engine is chosen by the SEARCH_DRIVER env var (postgres | meilisearch | elasticsearch | null).

request.description: Searches every index at once. Response contains `hits[]` (flat across indexes) plus `byIndex` broken down into products/categories/users/reviews.

query.description: Comma-separated. One or more of: products, categories, users, reviews.

request.description: `q` is required. The server returns 422 when it is missing or blank.
